transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, nice to meet you too. Well, I guess what really pushed me to come in is... I've been having this issue at work. I work at a front desk, and lately, every time a door slams or someone just rolls a suitcase fast across the lobby, I completely jump. 

It’s like my body thinks it’s happening again. My heart just starts pounding, and it takes me a good minute to get my heart rate back down and focus on my job. It's just really starting to bother me.
Did something traumatic happen to you before these reactions started?
Yeah, it did. Um... this has all been going on for about two weeks now. It started right after this one guest got really aggressive and actually threatened me while I was working at the front desk.
Since that incident, have unwanted memories of it been popping into your mind when you don’t want them to?

Yeah, they do. It happens completely out of nowhere, honestly. I'll just be trying to answer a normal phone call, and suddenly I get this clear picture in my head of that guest leaning over the counter and knocking the equipment toward me. It just pops up even when I'm trying to focus on something else.
Since that incident, have you been avoiding anything that reminds you of what happened?

Yeah, I have. Um, lately I’ve been taking the back hallway at work whenever I can. Just walking past the actual spot in the lobby where it happened... it makes my chest tighten up, and I just want to get away from it. So I try to avoid going through there as much as possible.
Since that incident, have you been feeling constantly on guard or watchful, even when there isn’t any clear danger?

No, I wouldn't really say that. I mean, obviously I get tense around the lobby, but... no, otherwise I don't think I'm constantly watching my back or anything. When I'm at home or just out doing normal things, I feel pretty regular. So, no, I haven't really noticed feeling on guard all the time.
Has it been more than one month since the incident happened?
No, it hasn't been that long. It's been about two weeks since it happened... since that guest threatened me at the front desk. So, yeah, just two weeks.
Since the incident, have you been unable to feel positive emotions, like happiness or closeness to other people?

No, I wouldn't say that. I still feel normal emotions for the most part. I'm still happy when I see my friends, and I still feel close to my family. It's really just that specific area at work that messes with me. Other than that, my feelings haven't really changed.
Since the incident, have there been moments when you felt like it was happening again, as if you were back there in the lobby?

No, I haven't really had anything like that. I mean, I remember it clearly, of course, especially when I'm at work, but I never actually feel like I'm back in that moment or like it's happening all over again. It's just a memory.
Since the incident, have you been unable to remember an important part of what happened?

No, I remember everything. I mean... unfortunately, it's pretty clear in my head. I don't think there are any blank spots or anything like that. I haven't forgotten any important parts of what he said or did.
